title: Tap Out or Go Home
flavorText: The truest test of a technical wrestler is not how hard you can hit — it's how long your opponent can hold on. Make them tap.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Submission segment rule.
conditions: No pinfalls — submission is the only victory condition.

title: Say Those Two Words!
flavorText: You can take all the punishment in the world. But once you say those two words... it's over. Make sure it's THEM saying it.
objective: Win an I Quit match without using any Recovery action.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the I Quit Match segment rule.
conditions: You may not play any Recovery action cards for the duration of the match.

title: Climb Every Mountain
flavorText: The gold hangs above the ring. All you have to do is climb. Everyone else in the match has exactly the same idea.
objective: Win a Ladder match. Your wrestler starts with 5 fewer Stamina than normal.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Ladder Match segment rule. Reduce your starting Stamina by 5 before the match begins.

title: Rest in Pieces
flavorText: The lid creaks. The darkness calls. The only thing between your opponent and the casket... is you.
objective: Win a Casket match after your Health has been reduced to 5 or lower at some point.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Casket Match segment rule.
conditions: The win only counts if your Health reached 5 or lower at some point during the match.

title: Everything and the Kitchen Sink
flavorText: Tables. Ladders. Chairs. The holy trinity of mayhem. Welcome to the most dangerous arena in custom content.
objective: Win a TLC match without using chair-based abilities until your opponent is below 50% Health.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Tables, Ladders and Chairs (TLC) segment rule.
conditions: You may not play chair-based ability cards until your opponent has less than 50% Health remaining.

title: Last One Left
flavorText: One by one they'll fall. Pinfall. Submission. It doesn't matter how — what matters is that you're the last one standing.
objective: Win a 3-way Elimination match without being eliminated at any point.
setupInstructions: 3-way Elimination match, standard setup. Apply the Elimination segment rule.
conditions: If you are pinned or submitted at any point, the win does not count for this challenge.

title: Gauntlet of Legends
flavorText: One after another they keep coming. Each opponent fresher than the last. Only the most durable champions survive.
objective: Win a 4-opponent Gauntlet starting at 50% Stamina. No Taunts between matches.
setupInstructions: 4-opponent Gauntlet, standard setup. Apply the Gauntlet segment rule. Reduce your starting Stamina by half (round down) before the first match.
conditions: No Taunt actions may be used between matches.

title: The Match Beyond
flavorText: Two rings. One cage. Eight warriors. Once everyone is in, it's no longer about tactics. It's about survival.
objective: Win a War Games match as the team that enters the cage second.
setupInstructions: Standard War Games setup. Apply the War Games segment rule. Your team enters the cage second, giving the opposing team one extra entrant before 'The Match Beyond' phase begins.
conditions: Opposing team has one more entrant before the final phase.

title: Deadly Combat — Year One
flavorText: The Siberian prison yard goes silent as the guards escort the newest inmate into the pit. They call him OMZ — the Knockout Artist. Five tournaments. Five years. Freedom on the line. This is where it all began: Deadly Combat, the covert tournament where the world's most notorious criminals and fighters settle their scores. The first draw is the Homicidal, Suicidal, Genocidal one — Sabu — and in the pit the barbwire is live.
objective: Win a Barbwire Exploding Deathmatch as OMZ against Sabu.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion for Sabu. Play as OMZ. Use the Barbwire Exploding Deathmatch setup from the ATW Extreme rule book. Play solo on Medium difficulty, OR as a 2-player Barbwire Exploding Deathmatch (one player as OMZ, the other as Sabu).
conditions: The barbwire is live: board strikes and weapon shots carry their Extreme Edition consequences. Survive the wire and win.
modifiers: The Homicidal, Suicidal, Genocidal one feels nothing: the first time each turn that Sabu would be defeated, he may immediately make one free attack against OMZ before falling — the man wrestles like the wire owes him money.
Year One body: whenever OMZ is thrown into the barbs, he loses 1 extra [[stamina]] — the pit takes its tuition from everyone.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 1 of 5. Complete all five years to retrace OMZ's road from the pit to the promised land.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Two
flavorText: Word of the Knockout Artist spread through the cell blocks. Year two of Deadly Combat brought bigger monsters, bolder bruisers, and a rule the guards loved: no referee to stop anything. Tonight the pit belongs to the Whole Damn Show — Rob Van Dam — the most elastic fighter ever to walk out of the Extreme era, and the hardest man to keep down.
objective: Win a Last Man Standing match as OMZ against Rob Van Dam.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion for Rob Van Dam. Play as OMZ. Use the Last Man Standing setup from the Double Trouble rule book. Play solo on Hard difficulty, OR as a 2-player Last Man Standing match (one player as OMZ, the other as Rob Van Dam).
conditions: RVD must fail his own ten count to lose. Pinfalls don't end this — only standing does.
modifiers: The Whole Damn Show won't stay down: the first time Rob Van Dam reaches 0 [[health]], he rises to 5 [[health]] instead of falling. He's not called Mr. Monday Night for nothing.
No mercy in the pit: You cannot spend stamina to recover health.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 2 of 5. The Extreme era's franchise player stands between OMZ and year three.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Three
flavorText: Three years in. Three tournaments survived. By now the prison yard knew the ritual: every summer the guards cleared the block, the cage was bolted together over the concrete, and whoever stepped in last was meant to never step out. Year three's draw was the cruelest yet: the spider in the center of the web — Raven — and a cage with the door welded shut.
objective: Win a Cage match as OMZ against Raven.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion for Raven. Play as OMZ. Use the Cage match setup. Play solo on Hard difficulty, OR as a 2-player Cage match (one player as OMZ, the other as Raven).
conditions: The door is welded shut: the only way out is over the top or through the other man. Win by cage escape or by putting Raven down for the count, per the Cage match rules.
modifiers: The spider from the shadows: whenever Raven would Taunt, he instead deals 1 damage to OMZ — his mind games are a weapon, not a show.
Quoth the beaten man: the first time each turn OMZ's attack roll would miss, reroll it once — the Knockout Artist's hands never miss twice in the same turn.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 3 of 5. The cage keeps the crowd out and the damage in.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Four
flavorText: Four tournaments. Four trophies. Four years of men carried out of the pit on stretchers while OMZ walked out under his own power. The guards stopped betting against him; they started betting on how long the newcomers lasted. Year four's draw was the cruelest yet: Daemon, the Extreme expansion's own piece of the darkness, in a match where the only escape is saying the two words — and the darkness never quits.
objective: Win an I Quit Match as OMZ against Daemon.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion for Daemon. Play as OMZ. Use the I Quit Match setup. Play solo on Hard difficulty, OR as a 2-player I Quit Match (one player as OMZ, the other as Daemon).
conditions: Daemon only loses when he says 'I quit.' Beat it out of him.
modifiers: The darkness answers: the first time each turn that Daemon reaches 0 or fewer [[health]], roll the die; on an odd result he refuses to quit and rises at 3 [[health]] instead. The darkness does not negotiate.
No mercy in the pit: Daemon's player may not use Taunts to recover [[stamina]] — there is no showmanship in the pit, only the question.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 4 of 5. Extreme brings the darkness to the pit. One year remains.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Five: The Gauntlet
flavorText: Freedom. One more tournament and the gates open for the first time in five years. But the warden has seen enough of the Knockout Artist to rig the final draw: not one champion — four. The Homicidal one. The Whole Damn Show. The spider in the web. The darkness itself. One after another, no rest, no mercy. Gauntlet rules. Win them all, and walk out of Siberia a free man. This is the year that made the legend.
objective: Defeat Sabu, Rob Van Dam, Raven, and Daemon in gauntlet order as OMZ — four wins, one breath.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion. Health Pack tokens are available as part of the base game. Play as OMZ. Play solo on HARD for the standard gauntlet, or on LEGENDARY for the Warden's cruelty (see the modifiers marked LEGENDARY only). OR as a 2-player gauntlet (one player as OMZ, the other controlling all four opponents). Randomly select the first opponent; the remaining three follow in drawn order.
conditions: No pinfalls — gauntlet opponents are defeated when their Health reaches 1.
If OMZ falls at any point, the gauntlet restarts from the first remaining opponent.
modifiers: The pit medics: before each match after the first, OMZ is issued one [[Elixir]] token (triggers the moment his Health reaches 1: instantly restores 12 Health minus any excess damage from the fatal blow, then discard) and one [[Health Pack]] token (trigger during any kick-out after a devastating weapon attack: instantly restores 4 Health, then discard). Tokens do not carry over between matches.
No rest in the pit: before your first draw of each match after the first, randomly discard 2 cards from your deck — if one is OMZ's Finisher, shuffle it back into the deck and randomly discard again.
The fifth victory frees the man: when the last opponent's Health reaches 1, OMZ has won Deadly Combat five consecutive years and earns his freedom.
Warden's cruelty (LEGENDARY only): the medics only carry Elixir — no Health Pack in the pit.
Warden's cruelty (LEGENDARY only): discard 3 cards instead of 2, and the next opponent's player chooses one of the discarded cards to start the match with in hand.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 5 of 5 — the finale. Beat the gauntlet and write the legend's last line.
